destination.name: Budderoo National Park
destination.tagline: A rainforest and escarpment park with Minnamurra Rainforest and Carrington Falls.
destination.description: Budderoo National Park, opened in 1986 and covering 60 km2, is the Illawarra's rainforest park. Minnamurra Rainforest has elevated walkways, a visitor centre and the one-hour Lyrebird loop, while Carrington Falls, where the Kangaroo River drops 50 m, has three lookouts and rockpools. Nearby Macquarie Pass National Park adds a 2 km Cascades walk to a waterfall and pool.
whyVisit: See Carrington Falls from its lookouts
Hike the Cascades at Macquarie Pass

goodToKnow.title: Fee and hours
goodToKnow.detail: The Minnamurra Rainforest section costs $12 per vehicle and its gates are open 9 am–5 pm; other parts of the park are free.

goodToKnow.title: Bring food
goodToKnow.detail: There is nowhere in the park to eat beyond light refreshments at the visitor centre, so pack your own.

goodToKnow.title: Bus is limited
goodToKnow.detail: The Kiama bus to the rainforest runs once a day each way and only on weekdays, so a car is the practical way in.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} suit the rainforest: lyrebirds are courting in spring, and March follows the wettest months, when the falls run fullest.
